title: One DynamoDB table for Lighthouse platform state
scenario: The platform needs its own records next to AgentCore Memory: a session index with TTL, idempotency for tool side effects so a retried tool call never files a second request, a per-agent daily cost ledger from gen_ai span attributes, and approvals with optimistic locking. Design one table from the access patterns; tests run on moto.
task: Keys and at most two GSIs for six access patterns
Session index with 30-day TTL and a Query window
Idempotent side effects with conditional writes
Exact cost ledger with ADD on integer micro-dollars
acceptance: All access-pattern, retry and concurrency tests pass
No Scan; TTL in epoch seconds
ANSWER.md has the key table and the Memory vs table boundary
